menu_option_descriptions.pv_learn: The integration fits the orientation and size of each string to what your inverter measured. The first model is fitted from the recorder's history right after setup and improves with each weekly refit.
menu_option_descriptions.pv_fill: Your own numbers give better forecasts from day one; the integration still calibrates the scale.

pv_fill.title: Your solar panels
pv_fill.description: One row per string your inverter reports, and one for the GEN port when a microinverter feeds it. A peak power of 0 skips a string. Your own numbers give better forecasts from day one; the integration still calibrates the scale.

backtest.title: The backtest
backtest.description: Replays the shadow battery over your hourly history with the price history of the data pack; indicative, because hourly data flattens the quarters; on the reference house the hourly result was 93 % of the minute result. {start} {reason}

error.grid_pair: Give the grid meter's import and export counters together, or leave both empty.
error.floor_range: The lowest state of charge must be 95 % or less.
error.no_planes: Give at least one string a peak power above 0, or go back and let the integration learn the panels.

abort.no_solarman: BetteryBalance needs the Solarman integration (davidrapan/ha-solarman) with a Deye SUN-12K-SG04LP3 hybrid inverter on the deye_p3 profile. Other inverters are planned for plan 4: {issue_url}
abort.no_battery: No Solarman inverter in Home Assistant has a battery. BetteryBalance supports the Deye SUN-12K-SG04LP3 with a battery on the deye_p3 profile. Other set-ups are planned for plan 4: {issue_url}
abort.old_integration: This is the older Solarman integration ({detail}). BetteryBalance supports davidrapan/ha-solarman with the Deye SUN-12K-SG04LP3 on the deye_p3 profile. Other set-ups are planned for plan 4: {issue_url}
abort.single_phase: This inverter is single-phase (no {detail}). BetteryBalance supports the three-phase Deye SUN-12K-SG04LP3 on the deye_p3 profile. Other inverters are planned for plan 4: {issue_url}
abort.high_voltage: This is a high-voltage battery ({detail}). BetteryBalance supports the Deye SUN-12K-SG04LP3 with a 48 V battery. Other set-ups are planned for plan 4: {issue_url}
abort.missing_entity: An entity of the deye_p3 profile is missing or has no value: {detail}. BetteryBalance supports the Deye SUN-12K-SG04LP3 on the deye_p3 profile of davidrapan/ha-solarman. Other set-ups are planned for plan 4: {issue_url}
abort.already_in_progress: BetteryBalance is already being set up for this inverter.
abort.single_instance_allowed: BetteryBalance is already set up. One Home Assistant runs one BetteryBalance entry.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: The rule's knobs, prefilled with the shipped defaults. Change them only when you know why.

data_description.hurdle_ct_kwh: Smallest price spread in ct/kWh worth a trade, after fees, tax and losses.
data_description.wear_eur_cycle: Battery wear in EUR per full cycle, charged on each kWh the battery discharges.
data_description.q_take: Quantile of the take-price band that a charge must clear (lower is more careful).
data_description.q_feed: Quantile of the feed-price band that a discharge must clear (higher is more careful).
data_description.predicted_widen: Factor that widens the price bands of hours whose day-ahead price is not known.
data_description.terminal_target: State of charge the plan aims for at the end of its window.
data_description.latency_s: Seconds between a decision and the battery following it.
data_description.dwell_s: Seconds the battery holds an action before it may reverse.
data_description.trade_floor_w: Smallest battery power in W for a trade; smaller orders become hold.
data_description.kappa: Margin, in band half-widths, by which the live price must clear the threshold to commit.
data_description.latest_commit_min: Last minute of a quarter at which a trade may still start.
data_description.impl: Threshold method: dp (dynamic programming) or ranking.
data_description.commit_rule: Commit test: margin against the band, or expected_gain.
data_description.dual_penalty: Ranking only: penalise quarters that may settle at two prices.
data_description.boundary_precommit: At a quarter boundary, commit from the bands before the first live price.
data_description.second_plane_penalty: Relative fit error a second PV plane must save before the PV model takes it.
data_description.promotion_margin: Fraction by which a new site model must beat the current one to replace it.
data_description.drift_alarm: Weekly PV forecast error that raises the drift alarm.
data_description.learning_widen: Ranking only: factor that widens the need while the site models learn.
data_description.weekday_split: Fit separate load profiles for weekdays and weekends.
data_description.standby: Count the inverter's standby drain against the shadow battery.

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.description: An optional TenneT API key gives the 12-second live balance feed. Without one the minute feed runs. The intraday auction prices (IDA1 to IDA3) come from Nord Pool's data portal, whose terms do not allow automated extraction until the project has settled them with Nord Pool. The fetch is off by default, and the price model then works without them. Switch it on only when you have checked the terms for your own use.

data.fetch_ida: Fetch the intraday auction prices from Nord Pool

data.pool_results: Allow the results file for pooling
